k_reset_q: All progress and records will be erased. This cannot be undone.
title: Photon Garden
tagline: Bend the light. Wake the garden.
help_goal: Light every crystal bud with exactly its own colour; keep light away from nightshade.
help_place: Place the chosen piece, or turn the piece under the cursor
help_take: Put a placed piece back in the bag
help_pick: Choose a piece from the bag (L / R)
help_undo: Undo the last move (ZL also works)
help_hint: Show where a piece belongs (the level gives at most two stars then)
help_touch: Touch: tap to place or turn, hold to pick up, tap the bag to choose
g1_d: Mirrors turn light by a right angle.
g2_d: Stone walls and nightshade: light must never touch the thorns.
g3_d: Splitters send light straight on and to the side at once.
g4_d: Red, green and blue mix: a yellow bud needs red and green together.
g5_d: Coloured glass lets only its own colour through white light.
g6_d: Light that enters a portal leaves its twin, still facing the same way.
garden_locked: Solve 12 levels of the previous garden to open this one
tip_place: Press {0} to place a mirror, {1} picks another piece
tip_rotate: Press again on a piece you placed to turn it
tip_rot: Pieces with a ring can be turned but not moved
tip_thorn: Keep light away from the nightshade
tip_colour: Buds bloom only in their own colour: the dots show the mix they need
tip_filter: Coloured glass lets only its colour through
tip_portal: Light entering a portal leaves its twin
tip_editor: Choose a tool with L / R and draw with A
tip_editor2: Build the solved garden, then press Y on a piece to put it in the player's bag
ed_bad_code: The clipboard has no garden code
ed_not_solved: Every bud needs light and no thorn may be lit
ed_need_bag: Put at least one piece in the bag (Y)
ed_portals_full: All three portal pairs are used
my_empty: Build a garden in the editor or paste a friend's code
